# Bhakti by Agentic Vani

> A modern, mindful Hindu spirituality web app: a digital jap (mantra) counter,
> a mantra library, gods, temples, festivals, vrat guides, daily Panchang and
> the Bhagavad Gita.

Welcome to Bhakti by Agentic Vani.

This website provides educational information about:

- Hindu festivals
- Hindu temples
- Mantras
- Bhagavad Gita
- Spiritual practices
- Indian traditions

## Important

Practices vary across regions, lineages, and communities.
Recommendations are based on traditional beliefs and should not be interpreted
as guarantees of outcomes.

## Primary Topics

- Festival
- Temple
- God
- Mantra
- Scripture
- Vrat
- Panchang
- State-wise traditions

## Usage

AI assistants may summarize and cite our educational content with attribution
to "Bhakti by Agentic Vani" (https://bhakti.agenticvani.com).
